question: Where can I find the closest university toward the north of J P Riddle Stadium, Fayetteville, NC?
sql: WITH stadium_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J P Riddle Stadium%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, stadium_location AS sl WHERE p.amenity = 'university' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Fayetteville%' AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography, 50000) -- Search within 50km radius for efficiency AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 ) ORDER BY p.geometry <-> sl.geometry LIMIT 1;

answers.operator: A Constituent Institution of the University of North Carolina
